children: ICSID dismissed Gabriel Resources Ltd.'s application to annul the award rejecting its claims against Romania. The award remains in force, including an approximately $10M costs order; the company says limited liquidity puts its ability to continue as a going concern at risk.
The adverse ruling preserves a substantial obligation; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
Company says going-concern ability is at risk
The company has limited liquidity and says it needs funding to meet obligations, raising immediate survival risk.
This is part of a $3.4M private placement; the TSXV deadline is November 16, 2026, and proceeds are not assured.
Insolvency may leave shareholders with no recovery
The company says insolvency could also lead to trading suspension, delisting, or transfer to NEX.
The reimbursement offers limited offset; no interest or payment deadline was set.

This is a late-stage setback in Gabriel's long-running dispute with Romania, following the 2024 award rejecting its claims. The next catalysts are the outcome of the funding and restructuring review and whether the outstanding placement subscriptions close by the TSXV deadline.
from Gabriel Resources Ltd. distributed by ACCESS Newswire.
